answer.summary: E2E job failed because the OpenAEV API never started: Spring threw an UnsatisfiedDependency error during boot, so /api/me returned HTTP 000 for all 150 attempts. The PR is a Renovate bump of the eclipse-temurin base image in Dockerfile, so the change is a plausible cause, and a startup dependency error should repeat on rerun. The excerpt is truncated before the root-cause bean name, so this is not fully confirmed.
